# Vault Root

Four PARA containers, ordered by actionability:

* [0-Projects](/0-Projects/index.md) - active efforts with a finish line
* [1-Areas](/1-Areas/index.md) - ongoing responsibilities, never done
* [2-Resources](/2-Resources/index.md) - atomic Ideas, Literature Notes, Structure Notes by topic
* [3-Archives](/3-Archives/index.md) - retired items from the other three

Root files with reserved meaning:

* [Front door](/llms.txt) - the agent entry point; read this first
* [Update Log](/log.md) - chronological journal of Vault changes
* [Agent instructions](/AGENTS.md) - thin pointer for agent sessions started in the Vault
